witness.origin: From-scratch ezdxf 1.4.5 AC1018 DXF; locally converted using ODA File Converter 27.1.0 to AC1018 DWG and back to AC1018 DXF. No drawing payload is committed.
witness.input: Styles CTRL00/CTRL01/CTRL04/CTRL05 have group 70 values 0/1/4/5 and ltypeshp.shx; one LINE.
witness.output: ODA produced separate handles 0x2F, 0x30, 0x31 for values 0, 1, 4. The returned DXF STYLE at 0x30 has empty name (ezdxf style-table iteration omits this row) and raw group 70=1; 0x31 retains CTRL04 and group 70=4. LINE survived. CTRL05 was omitted, so no producer evidence is claimed for the combined 5 case. No .err file was produced.

bit_probe.method: A disposable instrumented copy of libdxfrw source 6034e221471df04f8b2d1f6f5835f8d87d717647 logged positions immediately after common xref flags, before reading the two STYLE bits; the probe uses the existing parser and is not an independent binary decoder. Bit offsets are relative to the decoded object buffer.
bit_probe.following_sentinel: LibreDWG 0.14 independently reports text size=0, width=1, oblique=0, generation=0, last height=2.5, font=ltypeshp.shx and empty big font on all three; ODA DXF reports matching fields.
bit_probe.independent_semantics: LibreDWG decodes 0x30 shape=true vertical=false and 0x31 shape=false vertical=true. The current native parser interprets these values oppositely (flags 68 and 65, including reference bit 64).

decision: ODA DWG v5.4.1 section 20.4.56 lists vertical before shape. AGENTS.md designates this PDF authoritative over conflicting byte-layout references. This physical producer counterexample does not override that instruction; parser and encoder remain unchanged and the ET file remains safely refused. Request an authoritative ODA clarification or user-approved rule change and qualify the version boundary, source references and write/readback before implementation.

diagnostic_fix.finding: An empty graph printed FIELDLIST-not-closed despite no FIELD/FIELDLIST carriers; this warning obscured the unrelated STYLE output refusal in ET-Drawing-with-Border.dwg (SHA-256 85819667e8e88366ca3d8f9a0dda9770f094b6445882e08e0b2b3bf983472f7b).
diagnostic_fix.change: Restrict the late warning to actual FIELD/FIELDLIST carriers. Earlier capture-failure and incomplete-graph preflight refusal and output behavior remain unchanged.
diagnostic_fix.validation: Before fix the new absent-graph test failed on the warning. After fix, ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R "^libdxfrw_field(list_membership_output|_graph_export_refusal)$" --output-on-failure passed both selectors, including incomplete-carrier rejection, destination preservation and corrected same-adapter retry.

limits: No full ET conversion success or DWG/DXF support claim follows.
The external ET drawing and locally generated DXF/DWG files are not committed.
This experiment is one ODA producer/version and one independent decoder, not evidence for all revisions or the combined flag state.
